subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Brave
solution:
The correct answer is '**Coward**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Brave**" refers to someone who is ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage. (बहादुर)

 
 
• **Example**: Despite the risk involved, the firefighter showed his **bravery **by rushing into the burning building to save lives.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym "**Coward**" means someone who lacks courage in facing danger, difficulty, opposition, pain, etc.; a timid or easily intimidated person. (कायर)
 
 
• **Example**: He was labeled a coward because he refused to stand up for what he believed in when confronted.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is '**Coward**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fearless **means not afraid; brave. (निडर).

 
 
• **Example**: The **fearless **child stood up to the bully without hesitation, showing true courage.
 
 
 
• **Adulterous **refers to someone involved in adultery, which means engaging in sexual relations with someone one is not married to. (व्यभिचारी).
 
 
• **Example**: The novel explored the consequences of an **adulterous **affair on a family.
 
 
 
• **Moving **as an option does not directly relate to bravery or its antonyms in terms of courage. "**Moving**" indicates causing deep emotional feelings (भावुक).
 
 
• **Example**: The soldier's letter home was **moving **and brought tears to his family’s eyes.
